model.stratum: Five of nine comparison-successor contract operations now have checked Agda interpretations as native rule applications: filler-as-compare-rule (BoundaryGeneratedQuestions), passive-frame-change (PassiveFrameTransport), reference-substitute, record-reindex, and family-admit (ContractInterpretations). The remaining four (comparison.fixed_frame, frame.active, history.edit, operand.pair) follow the same apply-a-native-rule pattern but are not yet coded as Agda modules.
model.next_falsifier: Change any imported native rule without recompiling the interpretation modules; the SCC check requires the .agdai interface file to be present.
